title: This smoothie stand hooked a whole island without a single ad

lines.tts: [intrigued] This smoothie stand hooked a whole island. Without a single ad.
lines.text: This smoothie stand hooked a whole island. Without a single ad.

lines.tts: At first, Lani paid Koa to shout ads. All day.
lines.text: At first, Lani paid Koa to shout ads. All day.

lines.tts: [booming, radio announcer] SMOOTHIES! GET YOUR SMOOTHIES!
Then Mele tried one... and ran to get her friends.
lines.text: Then Mele tried one... and ran to get her friends.

lines.tts: [excited] Guys! You HAVE to try this!
lines.text: Guys! You have to try this!

lines.tts: [lightbulb, excited] Wait. Bring a friend, and you BOTH get one free!
lines.text: Wait. Bring a friend, and you both get one free!

lines.tts: [building, faster] One became two. Two became four. Four became the whole damn island.
lines.text: One became two. Two became four. Four became the whole damn island.

lines.tts: That's a referral loop. Dropbox grew from a hundred thousand to four million users in fifteen months doing this.

lines.tts: Make customers your marketers. Reward both sides.
